set.pl: Agard's place on sec. 1 T3S R14W, Paw Paw Township, on the east bank of the Paw Paw River (1880 History of Berrien and Van Buren Counties)
acc: Private: permission. Agard's unmarked grave is on the same place: look only near any burial sign.
pinev: Sec. 1 T3S R14W, east strip on the east bank of the Paw Paw River (BLM PLSS), from the 1880 county history: "located in 1833 upon a place on section 1, east of Paw Paw River" (about 600 m)

tw-mi-agards-landing-gold.st: The 1880 county history says he "located in 1833 upon a place on section 1, east of Paw Paw River", kept a trading post with a dozen log huts, died in October 1835 and "was buried on his place".
src: History of Berrien and Van Buren Counties, Michigan (1880), Paw Paw Township chapter
